description: Rules from spec/00-overview.md §5-§7: record shape, version, timestamps, extensions.

vectors.name: core/minimal-record-accepted
vectors.description: Only the required members are present; the record is valid and declares no lifecycle.

vectors.name: core/unknown-members-accepted
vectors.description: A consumer must ignore members it does not recognise.

patch.org.example:note: written by a newer minor version

vectors.name: core/record-must-be-object
vectors.description: A JSON array is not a record.

vectors.name: core/version-is-major-minor
vectors.description: Three components are not a record format version.

vectors.name: core/version-required
vectors.description: A record without 'variorum' cannot be interpreted.

vectors.name: core/created-requires-offset
vectors.description: A local time without an offset is ambiguous and therefore invalid.

vectors.name: core/generated-at-requires-offset
vectors.description: CORE-6 applies to every timestamp, including recipe.generatedAt.

vectors.name: core/extensions-must-be-object
vectors.description: Extensions are a map from identifier to payload.

vectors.name: core/unnamespaced-extension-key-accepted
vectors.description: Namespacing an extension key is a SHOULD (CORE-10); violating it must not invalidate the record.

extensions.note: an un-namespaced key, which is a warning and not an error
